title: mcp-test-toolkit pytest options
description: The mcp_* options of the mcp-test-toolkit pytest plugin, in [tool.pytest.ini_options] (pytest 6 and later) or directly in [tool.pytest] (pytest 9 and later) of pyproject.toml.

IniOptions.$comment: additionalProperties is true because the options merge with pytest's and other plugins'

mcp_transport.description: Transport: memory, stdio, streamable_http, sse (default: memory). Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_TRANSPORT.

mcp_server_url.description: URL for streamable_http/sse transport (e.g. http://localhost:8080/mcp). Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_SERVER_URL.

mcp_server_command.description: Command for stdio transport (e.g. 'python -m my_server'). Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_SERVER_COMMAND.

mcp_timeout.description: Default timeout in seconds for MCP operations (default: 30).

mcp_snapshot_update.description: Update schema snapshots instead of comparing.

mcp_security_fail_on.description: Severity at which a security finding with no detector rule fails the run; a detector rule is decided by default-gate membership, never by this (default: HIGH).

mcp_security_promote_to_gating.description: Comma-separated check ids that fail the security gate whatever their severity, e.g. STATIC-003,STATIC-006 to fail CI on a tool with no MCP safety annotations (default: none). An unknown or model-judged id is refused. Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_SECURITY_PROMOTE_TO_GATING.

mcp_mcpwn_path.description: Path to mcpwn.py script for security scanning.

mcp_scan_encoded_credentials.description: Run the STATIC-033 decode-then-scan lane (decode base64/hex/etc candidate tokens and match the recovered plaintext) so an author-encoded hardcoded secret is caught (default: True). Disable via mcp_scan_encoded_credentials = false in pyproject.toml.

mcp_security_suppressions.description: Path to JSON suppressions file for false-positive management.

mcp_security_max_schema_depth.description: Maximum JSON Schema nesting depth for STATIC-004 (default: 15, OWASP).

mcp_sca_target_path.description: Directory or lockfile OSV-Scanner scans; required when enable_sca is set (no default).

mcp_eval_model.description: LLM model for eval judge (e.g. 'ollama/deepseek-r1'). Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_EVAL_MODEL.

mcp_eval_tier.description: Eval strategy tier (default: deterministic). Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_EVAL_TIER.

mcp_eval_cache_path.description: Path to JSONL eval response cache (default: .eval_cache.jsonl).

mcp_eval_disable_durability.description: Disable os.fdatasync() on JSONL store writes. Matches deepeval DEEPEVAL_DISABLE_DURABILITY / rsyslog sync / syslog-ng reliable(yes) / Braintrust BRAINTRUST_SYNC_FLUSH inverse polarity (default False preserves durability; True trades crash safety for throughput on hot-path caches). See DEC-216. Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_DISABLE_DURABILITY.

mcp_eval_record.description: Record fresh LLM responses to eval cache during LIVE tier.

mcp_eval_min_f1.description: Minimum composite F1 score for eval assertions (default: 0.0).

mcp_eval_fail_on.description: Minimum severity for deterministic eval findings to fail (default: MEDIUM).

mcp_eval_max_tools.description: Skip O(n^2) pairwise checks when tool count exceeds threshold (default: 500, 0=disable).

mcp_eval_num_samples.description: Number of LLM calls per case for statistical evaluation. >1 enables pass@k mode (default: 1).

mcp_eval_pass_at_k.description: The k in pass@k -- probability of passing in at least k of n attempts (default: 1).

mcp_eval_pass_threshold.description: Per-run composite score threshold for marking a run as a pass (default: 0.5).

mcp_eval_golden_path.description: Path to JSONL golden baseline file (default: .eval_golden.jsonl).

mcp_eval_golden_update.description: Bless current eval results as golden baselines (analogous to --snapshot-update).

mcp_eval_baseline_reset.description: Require an explicit planned CAS reset action; retain old epochs and golden references.

mcp_eval_baseline_regression_threshold.description: Score delta threshold for REGRESSION status.  When golden - actual exceeds this value, the metric is regressed (default: 0.05).

mcp_eval_baseline_regression_per_metric_.description: Per-metric override mapping for the regression threshold (DEC-291); comma-separated ``metric_name=threshold`` pairs (e.g. "f1=0.05,output_similarity=0.10"), each in [0.0, 1.0].

mcp_eval_baseline_output_similarity_thre.description: ngram_similarity cutoff for output matching in compare_to_baseline.  Below this value the diff is classified OUTPUT_CHANGED (default: 0.85).

mcp_eval_regression_metrics.description: Which score metrics trigger REGRESSION.  Leave unset/empty to monitor every metric (the default, matching evidently and nannyml peer-corpus convention).  Comma-separated list (e.g. "composite,f1") restricts to named metrics only.

mcp_eval_score_metric_missing_policy.description: Policy when a golden metric is absent from actual scores.  "raise" = hard fail; "emit_finding" = separate finding (default); "coerce_zero" = default to 0.0 (legacy).

mcp_eval_baseline_missing_policy.description: Policy when a case_id has no entry in the golden baseline store. "emit" = INFO finding (default, matches syrupy / jest-snapshot / insta / approvaltests); "silent" = legacy empty-list return; "error" = raise at the first un-blessed case.

mcp_eval_drift_method.description: Autocorrelation-correction strategy: "sigma_inflation" (default, lightweight VIF) or "prewhiten" (AR(1) residuals, requires statsmodels). Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_EVAL_DRIFT_METHOD.

mcp_eval_drift_min_samples.description: Minimum sample count for EWMA / CUSUM / OLS alerting.  Below this, running variance is too noisy for reliable drift detection.

mcp_eval_drift_ewma_lambda.description: EWMA smoothing factor in (0, 1].  Lower values smooth more aggressively.  Default 0.2 per Lucas & Saccucci 1990.

mcp_eval_drift_sigma_mult.description: Z-multiplier for EWMA / across-batch control limits.  Default 2.962, the exact Lucas-Saccucci 1990 Table 3 tabulated value for (lambda=0.2, ARL0=500).

mcp_eval_drift_cusum_k.description: CUSUM reference value (k) in sigma units.  Default 0.5 per Montgomery 2012.

mcp_eval_drift_cusum_h.description: CUSUM decision interval (h) in sigma units.  Default 4.0 (one-sided ARL0 ~ 339 per Siegmund 1985).

mcp_eval_pii_scan.description: Scan tool responses, agent outputs, and trace payloads for PII during eval orchestration and emit EVAL-Q-PII findings (default: True, severity INFO -- monitor-first per DEC-211). Disable via mcp_eval_pii_scan = false in pyproject.toml.

mcp_eval_pii_severity.description: Severity for EVAL-Q-PII findings when eval_pii_scan is True (default: INFO).

mcp_eval_pii_skip_tools.description: Comma-separated tool names to skip during PII scanning — for tools that produce numeric-heavy output (calculators, database queries) where PII patterns have high false-positive rates.

mcp_eval_pii_phone_enabled.description: Enable the phone number pattern in PII scanning (off by default due to 20-40% FP rate on MCP tool outputs per DEC-211 F3 research).

mcp_load_concurrency.description: Number of concurrent virtual users for load tests (default: 10).

mcp_load_session_mode.description: Session management strategy: reuse, per_request, pool, churn (default: pool).

mcp_load_max_p99.description: Maximum p99 latency threshold in ms (default: 0 = report-only).

mcp_load_churn_ops.description: CHURN mode: rotate session after N operations (default: 0 = no limit).

mcp_mcpdrill_path.description: Path to mcpdrill Go binary for distributed load testing.

mcp_security_extended_profile.description: Opt in to the security-extended detector profile per DEC-323 (CodeQL-selector-contract governance).  When True, judge-assisted detectors (engine=llm_judge, engine=llm_primary) and experimental rules participate in the scan; default-profile installs (False) keep the L1/L2 execution path network-egress-free.

mcp_security_probe_values.description: Opt in to the runtime toxic-flow gate's value-tagging stage.  When True, the gate scans each observed tool response and tags a tool that returned a credential or personal data as a sensitive read, so a benignly-worded source (a token in a field named 'data') enters the flow analysis its schema-name hid it from.  Read-only and monotone; default False keeps the name-based behaviour.

mcp_llm_detector_token_budget.description: Cumulative input+output token budget for the LLM-primary detector across one scan run (per-run scope per the CodeQL --ram-per-`database analyze` precedent; default ~$0.05 at gpt-5-mini list price).  Exhaustion raises LLMDetectorBudgetExceededError mid-scan; the downstream policy (mcp_llm_budget_exhaust_policy) decides whether to degrade-and-continue or hard-fail.

mcp_llm_budget_exhaust_policy.description: HYBRID budget-exhaust policy: "degrade" (default; emit a STATIC-032 degraded-coverage marker and continue scanning remaining tools — TruffleHog --results=unknown precedent), "hard_fail" (re-raise the exception; upper layer exits non-zero with structured-error JSON — CodeQL exit-100 precedent).

mcp_security_layer3_filter.description: Opt-in L3 ML false-positive filter (STATIC-034): "off" (default) passes Layer-2 credential findings through unfiltered; "on" annotates benign-context findings as ToolNoise suppressions via the hosted ML backend (POSTs the candidate text to mcp_security_layer3_filter_endpoint; the model runs server-side and never ships in the wheel).  Off by default even under security_extended_profile per DEC-323 default-gate determinism.

mcp_security_layer3_filter_endpoint.description: Hosted endpoint URL for the opt-in L3 ML false-positive filter (used only when mcp_security_layer3_filter is "on").  The model runs on the configured service and never ships in the wheel; candidate text is POSTed with the cached signed license lease, obtained with `mcp-testing auth <key>`.  No hosted endpoint is provided by default.  An empty value degrades the enabled filter to a STATIC-034 coverage marker.

mcp_security_schema_pins_path.description: Path to the JSON file storing TOFU schema pins for inputSchema drift detection (default: .mcp_schema_pins.json). Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_SCHEMA_PINS.

mcp_security_schema_pin_mode.description: TOFU schema-pin enforcement mode: "off" (disabled), "warn" (MEDIUM finding on drift, default), "fail" (HIGH finding on drift). Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_SCHEMA_PIN_MODE.

mcp_observer_timeout_seconds.description: Per-observer soft timeout in seconds.  An observer that does not complete within this many seconds is treated as one consecutive failure and counts toward the observer_circuit_breaker_threshold.  Default 1.0s; raise to 5.0s or higher for underpowered CI runners.  Set to 0 to disable timeout enforcement entirely (opt-out path: observer runs directly on the dispatch thread, useful when an in-process debugger is breakpointing inside an observer).  Enforcement uses a bounded ThreadPoolExecutor with a sliced Future.result poll loop — Ctrl-C latency is capped at the 50ms poll-slice duration regardless of observer hang time. Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_OBSERVER_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.

mcp_observer_pool_max_workers.description: Maximum number of concurrent observer threads in the bounded ThreadPoolExecutor used for pytest_mcp_finding_emitted dispatch.  Default 4 matches the typical xdist -n auto worker count on developer laptops; raise for high-throughput CI environments with many parallel test workers and registered observers.  Observers that time out occupy a slot until they return naturally; if all slots fill, further dispatches receive POOL_SATURATED and count toward the circuit breaker.  Ignored when observer_timeout_seconds=0 (opt-out path bypasses the pool entirely). Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_OBSERVER_POOL_MAX_WORKERS.

mcp_observer_circuit_breaker_threshold.description: Consecutive-failure count at which a misbehaving observer hookimpl is skipped for the rest of the session.  Default 5; compliance-grade suites may want to lower this to fail-fast. Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_OBSERVER_CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD.

mcp_eval_drift_fdr_method.description: Finite detector×case correction: BY by default; anchored_by keeps all BY rejections; bh/e_bh refuse. Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_EVAL_DRIFT_FDR_METHOD.

mcp_eval_drift_fdr_q.description: Pointwise FDR target for the complete registered detector×case family; must match the pre-data plan. Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_EVAL_DRIFT_FDR_Q.

mcp_eval_drift_sequential_mode.description: Repeated-look drift monitor: off (single registered look only), edetector_edbh (FDR <= q at stopping times with expected per-case observations <= H) or changepoint_ebh (FDR <= q at every stopping time). Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_EVAL_DRIFT_SEQUENTIAL_MODE.

mcp_eval_drift_sequential_detector.description: E-detector recursion for edetector_edbh: shiryaev_roberts or cusum; unused by other modes. Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_EVAL_DRIFT_SEQUENTIAL_DETECTOR.

mcp_eval_drift_sequential_horizon.description: Declared horizon H for edetector_edbh: the bound on the expected number of observations per case, Phase I included, when the monitor stops. e-d-BH runs at level q/H. Unused by other modes. Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_EVAL_DRIFT_SEQUENTIAL_HORIZON.

mcp_eval_drift_sequential_q.description: FDR target over the registered case family at the reporting stopping time of the repeated-look monitor; distinct from the single-look detector-by-case q. Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_EVAL_DRIFT_SEQUENTIAL_Q.

mcp_eval_drift_max_records.description: Maximum active drift observations; 0 disables pruning. The actual registered provider archives older source generations without resetting baselines, epochs or inference. Full replay remains linear. Environment variable: MCP_TEST_TOOLKIT_EVAL_DRIFT_MAX_RECORDS.

mcp_gate_trigger_allow.description: Comma-separated list of entry-point plugin names permitted to contribute additional gate-trigger paths via the ``mcp_test_toolkit.gate_triggers`` entry-point group.  Default empty — no third-party autoload at 1.0.

mcp_skill_bundle.description: Path to the Agent Skill bundles under test: a SKILL.md file, or a directory tree in which every SKILL.md beneath it is checked.  Unset, the skill_bundle fixture looks for a 'skills' directory and then a '.claude/skills' directory under the rootdir. Environment variable: MCP_SKILL_BUNDLE.

mcp_skill_bundle.description: Path to the Agent Skill bundles under test: a SKILL.md file, or a directory tree in which every SKILL.md beneath it is checked.  Unset, the skill_bundle fixture looks for a 'skills' directory and then a '.claude/skills' directory under the rootdir. Environment variable: MCP_SKILL_BUNDLE.
